page.content:
Supreme Allied commander for the invasion of northwest Europe.

How Dwight D. Eisenhower connects

  • Event: D-Day — Eisenhower commanded the Overlord landings.
  • Faction: Allies — Eisenhower was supreme Allied commander in the west.

What is Dwight D. Eisenhower?

Dwight D. Eisenhower ran the Mediterranean then Overlord. D-Day and the campaign into Germany were his coalition command problem as much as a U.S. army problem.

Key threads lead to D-Day and Allies.
